description: This file defines the class 'FormRenderer', which provides mechanisms for rendering various types of forms (single, list, multi, upload) in a web application. It includes logic for rendering form headers, rows, fields, and manages context and pagination. The class interacts with other widget models and renderers to produce the final form output, supporting complex form structures with grouping, headers, and dynamic field rendering.

classes.name: FormRenderer
classes.description: A form rendering engine class responsible for rendering various form types with support for headers, rows, fields, grouping, and pagination logic. It interacts with model forms and renderers to generate the final form output in a web environment.

methods.name: getCurrentContainerId
methods.description: Computes the current container ID for the form, considering item indices and container ID patterns.

methods.name: getCurrentFormName
methods.description: Determines the current form name, optionally appending item indices for list types.

methods.name: getFocusFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the focus field name based on the context, defaulting to empty if not set.
